Description
Welcome to 1545 Franklin Street!
Prime Lower Pac Heights location, 4 bedrooms, 2 full baths plus half bath, spacious living room, eat-in kitchen and in unit laundry!
Located right in the heart of Lower Pacific Heights / Nob Hill, block and a half from Whole Foods, a few blocks from Lafayette Park. Easy public transportation to all parts of the city and close to 101, 280 for the commuters.
Ascend into this super spacious, full floor flat up the gracious staircase which opens into a large foyer.  In the back of the flat you will find the spacious living room adjacent to the recently remodeled kitchen with gas stove, hood and refrigerator.  Ample cabinet and counter space.
Situated in the front of the flat is one of the four bedrooms with large bay windows and a decorative fireplace.
In the center of the flat you will find two additional bedrooms with a shared half bathroom.  4th bedrooms as well as a bonus room are further down the hall as well as two full size bathrooms with shower over tub.
An in unit washer/dryer make laundry a delight in the spacious laundry room.
